result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue where the promotional banner text has extremely low contrast against its light background.

issues.description: The promotional banner near the top displays white text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout • min. order €10') on a very light mint green background, resulting in poor legibility and failing WCAG contrast requirements.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text color to a dark shade (such as dark green or charcoal) or darken the background color of the promotional card so the white text has sufficient contrast.
